backend/main.mo: Motoko actor with access control that manages user profiles and habit data, including habit creation, completion tracking, and optional volume tracking.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature IDs to related frontend files, components, and test requirements with confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing functionality of various frontend files for reference or documentation.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variable definitions for light and dark modes using OKLCH color values.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app wiring QueryClientProvider, header, BecomingView, footer, and global toaster.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthRequire: Sign‑in required alert with Internet Identity login button.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthStateIn: Badge showing signed‑in or signed‑out status based on Internet Identity state.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Internet Identity sign‑in/out button with reactive status handling and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/features/becoming/api/queri: React Query hooks for loading and mutating habits with actor‑timeout handling and error propagation.
frontend/src/features/becoming/component: Main view that handles auth, data loading, error states, and renders month tabs, habit manager, and the habit grid.
Displays an error alert with the error message and an optional retry button.
Renders a loading skeleton mimicking the habit grid layout while data is loading.
Modal for editing a habit's name, unit type, and monthly volume with validation and save mutations.
Displays the habits in a scrollable grid with day columns and renders a message if no habits exist.
Defines layout constants and helpers for consistent grid sizing and day column classes.
Provides UI for adding a new habit, toggling between button and input modes.
Renders a single habit row with info, day checkboxes, and actions including editing and completion toggling.
Popover menu providing an action to edit a habit when its info cell is clicked.
Renders selectable tabs for each month of 2026 and notifies parent on month changes.
frontend/src/features/becoming/constants: Provides month metadata for 2026 and helpers to retrieve month info and day counts.
frontend/src/features/becoming/state/hab: Provides helpers to build and query habit completion maps and compute volume display strings and monthly totals.
frontend/src/features/becoming/utils/tim: Validates, parses, formats, and normalizes time strings for habit volume inputs.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActorWithTimeout.t: Creates an identity‑based backend actor with a timeout and manual retry handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements context and provider for Internet Identity login, storage, and status handling.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind-based global styles and a light-themed design system with glass surfaces and mobile touch optimizations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading URL params (including hash routing) and persisting them in sessionStorage, plus functions to clear stored or hash-based parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme extensions, color variables, typography, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Project state file describing current issues, feature requirements, and metadata for fixing mobile loading hangs after Version 18.
